> Haven't you ever forgotten to water you plant for a couple of days, and when you remembered it was fully unrecoverable? Well, ... I have. And more than one! That's why I thought of making a moisture sensor for plants. It's a stick-like PCB with two copper lines at the end. You stick the PCB in the soil and it tells you whether the plant needs water or not with an LED. It's powered with a simple CR2023 coin battery.
